data.title: It 'hurts' says Messi of decision to retire from international football
data.description: MIAMI - Lionel Messi said on Monday he is retiring from international football after leading Argentina to a second successive World Cup final in July.

data.title: Thai queens rule Asia and book LA
data.description: <p>There were tears of joy in Tianjin on Sunday night as Thailand made history after securing their first ever Olympic qualification.</p>

data.title: Thais roar into Olympic history
data.description: <p>Thailand stunned Asian volleyball powerhouse China in Tianjin on Sunday night, coming from behind to win 3-2 in the final and qualify for the Olympic Games in women's volleyball for the first time.</p>

data.title: Thai volleyballers return triumphantly ahead of Asian Games
data.description: Players and staff of the Thai women’s volleyball team arrived at Suvarnabhumi airport in Samut Prakan on Monday night, where fans gathered to welcome them home after their crucial victory secured a place at the 2028 Olympic Games.

data.title: ONE Championship releases six fighters from roster, including Sanzhar Zakirov and Jeremy Miado
data.description: ONE Championship has released six fighters from its roster.

data.title: Poorly Djokovic crashes out of US Open first round
data.description: NEW YORK - Ailing Novak Djokovic suffered his earliest Grand Slam exit in 20 years on Sunday, falling in five brutal sets to Mariano Navone in the first round of the US Open.

data.title: Injuries cloud tennis as US Open gets under way
data.description: NEW YORK - After Carlos Alcaraz and Jannik Sinner split last year's Grand Slams, the two superstars were expected to continue their see-saw rivalry in 2026.

data.title: Thai volleyballers bringing home Asian title and Olympic ticket
data.description: Thai spikers are due back in Bangkok on Monday night after their heroic performance, securing an automatic Olympic berth as the Asian champions.

data.title: Back-to-back titles for Sarut
data.description: <p>Sarut Vongchaisit eagled the first playoff hole to defeat Peradol Panyathanasedh and secure his second consecutive title at the Singha Bangkok Open 2026 at Bangkok Golf Club in Pathum Thani yesterday.</p>

data.title: Thailand eye qualification despite tough U20 draw
data.description: <p>Thailand U20 head coach Jakkrapan Punpee believes his team could qualify for the 2027 AFC U20 Asian Championship in China despite being placed in a tough group for the qualifying competition.</p>

data.title: Jai's hat-trick of golds helps                         Thais top Asian track charts
data.description: <p>Jai Angsuthasawit claimed his third gold medal of the Track Asia Cup 2026 on Sunday, powering to victory in the men's individual sprint to cap a dominant showing that lifted Thailand's cycling team to three golds, one silver and two bronzes at the three-day meet in Bangkok.</p>

data.title: Fernandes treble inspires Man Utd rout, Chelsea beat Brighton in thriller
data.description: LONDON - Bruno Fernandes starred with a hat-trick in Manchester United's 5-2 rout of Ipswich, while Chelsea extended Xabi Alonso's perfect start with a thrilling 4-3 win against Brighton on Sunday.

data.title: ONE Championship: Ubaid Hussain targets Qatar, Johan Ghazali after US$100,000 contract win
data.description: Ubaid Hussain has set his sights on ONE Championship’s 2027 return to Qatar after finally securing a US$100,000 main-roster contract – with Johan Ghazali already emerging as a potential future rival.

data.title: Sarut in charge after solid day at Bangkok Open
data.description: <p>Sarut Vongchaisit fired an eight-under-par 62 to take the third-round lead at the three-million-baht Singha Bangkok Open at Bangkok Golf Club in Pathum Thani yesterday.</p>

data.title: Sprinters strike gold at Track Asia Cup despite rain-shortened finals
data.description: Thailand's men's team sprint squad claimed gold at the Track Asia Cup 2026 yesterday, posting the fastest qualifying time before a violent downpour forced officials to abandon the final and decide medals on qualification times alone.

data.title: 'Raising the Game': Thai League 1 launches 30th anniversary season
data.description: Thailand's top football division marked three decades of existence on Friday, unveiling the 2026-27 Thai League season under the slogan "Raising the Game" as it seeks to push the domestic game closer to international standards.

data.title: Spikers earn  shot at 2028  Games spot
data.description: Thailand will have an opportunity to fight for an Olympic berth after booking their berth in the final of the 2026 AVC Women's Volleyball Asian Championship in Tianjin on Saturday.

data.title: ONE Championship: Nico Carrillo posts negative anti-doping result after Superbon calls for drug test
data.description: Nico Carrillo has hit back at Superbon’s call for him to be drug-tested by publishing a ONE Championship letter stating that his latest in-competition anti-doping test returned a negative result.

data.title: Jai sets tone with opening day gold at Huamark track
data.description: <p>Thailand's Jai Angsuthasawit delivered a timely boost to the Kingdom's Asian Games medal hopes, edging out Australia's Xavier Bland in a thrilling keirin finish at the Track Asia Cup 2026 at Huamark Velodrome yesterday.</p>

data.title: Shock results rock every division of English game
data.description: <p>It may be a clich&eacute; that what makes football such a popular sport is its unpredictability, but this was very much in evidence last weekend in England when there were major upsets in every division, including wins for two newly promoted sides in the Premier League.</p>

data.title: Thailand draw Iraq, HK in U17 Asian Cup qualifiers
data.description: <p>Thailand have been drawn against Iraq, Hong Kong, Taiwan and the Maldives in Group B of qualifying for the AFC U17 Asian Cup Uzbekistan 2027.</p>

data.title: Thailand, Japan face off for final spot
data.description: <p>Defending champions Thailand will take on arch-rivals Japan in the semi-finals of the AVC Women's Volleyball Continental Championship 2026 at Tianjin Olympic Center Gymnasium today.</p>

data.title: Puripol fired up for gold after his European stint
data.description: <p>Puripol Boonson will shoulder Thailand's hopes for a gold medal at next month's Asian Games in Japan after the sprinter recorded impressive times during a training stint in Europe, said the Athletics Association of Thailand during the third session of the Meet the Press on Friday.</p>
